controlled_change: Native decode-only packed-r2 vs reference Q4 at 1072 and 1460 expert slots, A B C D then D C B A. Same mixed checkpoint, Q4 records, core-cache residency, schedules, memory ceiling and sampling.
correctness: 72 native tests (49201 assertions), 265 Python tests, 64 real native expert/input cases, and both all-48-layer state arms pass. Exact logits/routes/persistent state, continuation vs fresh replay, 32-slot forced eviction and cancellation/failure drains under Metal validation. Timed outputs/reuse and expected dispatch counts match in every arm.
decision_origin: authored interpretation; original report statuses retained
expected_effect: Meet the combined initial/append decode and whole-conversation gates at an unchanged 12GiB maximum.
hypothesis: Packed Q4 expert arithmetic and a larger expert cache can combine to save at least 20ms per decode token in normal coding conversations.
limitations: Two directional pairs per arm; no confidence-qualified gain or regression claim.
Short 72-token prompt and retained 128-token append, with 32 decode forwards each; not 2K/4K or 20-minute acceptance.
Full-model correctness is native-reference parity on the checked short history, not a new independent model oracle.
Memory observations are sampled boundaries, not continuous OS tracking.
The experimental packed path remains opt-in; production defaults and precision are unchanged.
outcome: All eight normal conversations completed in 519.14 seconds with clean observed memory. Q4 alone slowed initial/append decode by paired medians of 3.72/7.27 percent at 1072 slots and 3.39/8.60 percent at 1460. Combined D/A saved 11.74ms initially but lost 1.54ms after append, with whole-conversation latency 1.98 percent worse. Cache alone saved 20.91/23.18ms per decode token but append TTFT regressed 7.00 percent. Only the clean-memory gate passed. Both source/result audits passed.
smallest_experiment: Retain reference Q4 and 1072 slots; do not run five pairs or long acceptance on unchanged packed-r2. Investigate why full-request GPU command durations fail to reproduce the isolated Q4 gain before selecting another kernel candidate.
